Definition: to run (for whatever reason, especially to rush)
BiblicalUsage: The Hebrew word rûwts means to run (for whatever reason, especially to rush). It stands in 1 Kings 1:5, "…Adonijah the son of Haggith exalted himself, saying…", and in 1 Samuel 3:5, "And he ran unto Eli, and said, Here…".
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that rûwts counts, because God put it in his book.
